stock.description: Town Health International Medical Group Limited is an investment holding company primarily engaged in the investment, operation, and provision of diverse healthcare and related services across mainland China and Hong Kong. Its operations are segmented into Hong Kong Medical Services, Hong Kong Managed Medical Network Business, Mainland Hospital Management and Medical Services, and other business activities. The group delivers a wide array of healthcare offerings, including cross-border healthcare, managed care programs, medical diagnostics, comprehensive health screenings, and specialized ophthalmology services. It also functions as a third-party administrator for medical networks. Complementary services encompass general medical and dental consultations, medical tourism, and property investment. Furthermore, Town Health expands its scope to beauty and cosmetic medicine, laboratory testing, hospital management, vision care, and business and corporate advisory. Non-core operations include trading listed securities, property leasing, and the distribution of medical equipment and pharmaceuticals. By the end of 2021, the company commanded a substantial network of 454 healthcare service points. This extensive infrastructure featured 259 general practice clinics, 75 specialist centers, 23 dental clinics, and 97 auxiliary service facilities. Founded in 1989, the company initially operated as Town Health International Investments Limited before rebranding to Town Health International Medical Group Limited in March 2014. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Shatin, Hong Kong.
